claim: Finite source-hashed audit of observed parser limitations; paired independent witnesses distinguish the causes. This is not a C parser adequacy proof.

typedef_enumerator.cause: The enumerator parser demands ID, while the lexer returns TYPEID for a still-visible outer typedef. The enumerator is an ordinary-identifier binder and may legally hide that outer name.

witness.source: typedef int T; void f(void) { int n = (enum {T})1 + T; }

control.source: typedef int T; void f(void) { int n = (enum {K})1 + K; }

declaration_without_declarator.cause: The standard's declaration production has an optional init-declarator-list. These particular declarator-free declarations violate the separate 6.7p2 constraint; GCC/Clang diagnose and accept, while pycparser's AST builder refuses them.

vla_leading_dereference.cause: The array suffix parser consumes any leading * as the lone prototype [*] case and immediately requires ], excluding the distinct assignment-expression alternative with unary dereference.

gnu_builtin_type_context.cause: Preprocessed system headers use the compiler's predefined GNU __builtin_va_list type. pycparser starts with an empty type environment and treats the spelling as ID, then diagnoses a missing type. Later GNU syntax in the same file is not reached by this first failure.

typedef_spelled_label.cause: A label spelling that is also a typedef is lexed TYPEID; block-item classification treats it as a declaration. goto also insists on ID although label and ordinary identifier namespaces are distinct.

witness.source: typedef int T; void f(void) { T: ; }

control.source: typedef int T; void f(void) { L: ; }

initializer_binding_too_late.cause: _parse_init_declarator parses the initializer before _build_declarations registers the new ordinary identifier. The initializer thus still tokenizes the shadowed spelling as TYPEID even though its declarator is complete.

witness.source: typedef int T; void f(void) { int T = sizeof((int)T); }

control.source: typedef int T; void f(void) { int x = sizeof((int)x); }

for_scope_not_restored.cause: Iteration parsing creates no scope frame for the for statement. The local int T remains in the containing brace scope and masks the outer typedef at the following T x declaration.

witness.source: typedef int T; void f(void) { for (int T=0;;) break; T x; }

control.source: typedef int T; void f(void) { for (int i=0;;) break; T x; }

sizeof_compound_literal.cause: sizeof accepts a parenthesized type name immediately without checking for a following compound-literal body. It leaves {1} unconsumed instead of choosing sizeof unary-expression.

compound_literal_postfix.cause: The compound-literal branch returns before running the postfix suffix loop. Thus a following member selection .x is rejected although compound literals are postfix expressions.

duplicated_void.cause: pycparser accumulates simple type specifiers and concatenates them, accepting void void. C11 6.7.2p2 forbids this type combination; Cesta's declared constraint-sensitive specifier refactoring refuses it, as do both compilers.

missing_type_implicit_int.cause: The external-definition parser deliberately supplies C89 implicit int, or fills a missing type when declaration specifiers contain only a function specifier. The requested C11 source/profile requires the type-bearing declaration specifiers.

nonfunction_external_body.cause: After deleting struct, the oracle's implicit-int function-definition branch accepts an ordinary non-function declarator followed by a brace body. The resulting FuncDef has a TypeDecl, not FuncDecl; neither C11 nor either compiler admits this source.

scope_underflow_exception.cause: Deleting an opening brace or duplicating a closing brace invokes the lexer's close-brace callback with only the file scope remaining. _pop_scope asserts; this is an invalid oracle result, not a ParseError or acceptance.

aggregate_names_exception.cause: Deleting the semicolon between aggregate declarations lets adjacent aggregate specifiers reach the malformed-declaration repair branch, which accesses .names on Struct/Union nodes. These classes do not have that field; this is an invalid oracle result.

witness.source: struct S { int x; } struct T { int y; };

control.source: struct S { int x; }; struct T { int y; };

if_scope_not_restored.cause: The selection statement needs its own scope; an enum constant in the controlling expression must not hide an outer typedef after the statement.
